nutshell.headline: An ordinary PVF gift supports a broad clinical, educational and facilities portfolio—not only selected cataract cases.
nutshell.body: Central whole-gift donor cost is $17,857,143 per10 SF QALYs, $7,936,508 Bay and $7,142,857 US. The historical $714,286 selected-case calculation remains a conditional program comparison, not the organization headline.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: PVF supports a real shared pathway for uninsured people to receive earlier eye care, alongside clinician training and infrastructure.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Only first-eye earlier-care health is quantified. Marginal allocation, actual earlier access, first-eye case mix and residence are unmeasured. Partner outcomes cannot all be attributed independently to PVF.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: No verified ordinary-gift allocation, costed extra surgical cohort or counterfactual queue. The partial-health model does not establish a threshold-passing recommendation.

programSection.body: PVF funds eye-care access, education/research and the institute. It controls a real-estate entity and holds91% of PVSC LLC in the FY2024 filing. Lions and CPMC partners examine, refer and treat patients. The current charity pathway includes non-cataract care; low-vision rehabilitation and training are not assigned invented QALYs.

steps.title: Allocate the ordinary gift
steps.detail: 10% first-eye support;10% other clinical,15% education/research,40% building/capital and25% central/other support. These are explicit priors, not audited shares.

steps.title: Support unique assigned courses
steps.detail: $10,000 at$1,000/course funds10 nominal first-eye courses;50% financing additionality yields5 added courses. Failed referrals stay within course costing.

steps.title: Transfer the finite trial contrast
steps.detail: 0.056 integrated one-year trial QALY ×50% local clinical/comparator fit; no second eye, extra duration, success multiplier or lifetime blindness avoidance.

steps.title: Retain partners and regional scope
steps.detail: One shared outcome, outside clinical inputs, real later-care baseline and nested patient-residence priors. SF clinical location alone is insufficient.

programSection.boundary: The current patient page specifies uninsured physician-referred Lions patients. Broader impact-report underinsured wording is not assumed to expand core eligibility.

model.headline: Whole-gift cost with a finite, already-integrated first-year health stream
model.body: The modeled benefit is earlier first-eye surgery versus otherwise delayed surgery, not permanent denial. The legacy clinical coefficient is unchanged; the revision corrects the donation and geographic scope.

equation.label: Whole gift, finite first-eye assignment effect
equation.expression: Nominal courses = gift × first-eye allocation / direct cash per course. Added courses = nominal × financing additionality. Benefit = added × integrated first-year trial QALY × local clinical/timing transfer. Subtract added-course extra harm and independent gift-date losses. Regional Q = benefit × benefit share − losses × loss share. All price numerators retain the entire gift.
equation.result: US0.14 /Bay0.126 /SF0.056 QALYs. SF donor/gross/net prices $17,857,143 /$22,321,429 /$17,923,113 per10 QALYs.

inputs.label: Whole unrestricted gift
inputs.basis: Entire ordinary gift retained; no priced restricted offer.

inputs.label: Direct first-eye course allocation
inputs.basis: Marginal portfolio prior, not historical charity-care expense ratio. Other90% cost retained.

inputs.label: Direct cash per assigned unique first-eye course
inputs.basis: Legacy constructed cash budget includes referral/noncompletion costs. Separate portfolio allocation retains central costs; no second-eye benefit.

inputs.label: Integrated first-year trial QALY effect
inputs.basis: Economic randomized-assignment analysis among288/306 with six-month utility extrapolation; not a local observed effect or full-cohort outcome.
inputs.confidence: External integrated economic-trial result; transfer uncertain

inputs.label: Local clinical/comparator transfer
inputs.basis: Joint population, severity, actual waiting-time and pathway-fit prior. No permanent-denial or lifetime extension.

inputs.label: Funding additionality
inputs.basis: Added support versus existing PVF/Lions/CPMC/clinical financing; distinct from clinical transfer.

inputs.label: Extra shared harm per added course
inputs.basis: Outside complications already incorporated in trial. Costs of failed referrals remain.

inputs.label: Independent donor harm
inputs.basis: Independent of additional surgery; no second discount.

inputs.label: Other displaced care health
inputs.basis: Distinct lost alternative clinic/resource use; not canceled by zero cataract effect.

inputs.label: Outside public resources
inputs.basis: Narrow uninsured route, not proof of zero public resources throughout organization/partners. Real inputs only, no transfer sum.

inputs.label: Outside private/partner resources
inputs.basis: Clinical/facility/lens inputs beyond direct cash and internal charity transfer. Unpriced prior, not charges.

inputs.label: Otherwise later outside-care resources
inputs.basis: Unpriced offset conditional on later surgery, not permanent denial. No offset to retained whole-gift cash.

inputs.label: Timing of counterfactual outside cost
inputs.basis: Cost valuation parameter; health remains the already integrated one-year trial transfer. Shorter clinical wait requires separate clinical transfer judgment.

inputs.label: Continuous resource discount
inputs.basis: No extra within-year health discount applied to integrated trial result.

inputs.label: Other net real resource savings
inputs.basis: Separate resource savings, not patient welfare or transfers; negative denotes additional cost.

inputs.label: Bay share of benefit
inputs.basis: Unmeasured future residence share, not geography inferred from SF clinic location.

inputs.label: SF share of benefit
inputs.basis: Independent nested residence prior; wider California/Nevada pathway retained.

inputs.label: SF share of losses
inputs.basis: Can differ from health share; regions never summed.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: Joint favorable donor price is not a calibrated interval or expected return; no tuning to meet $100,000/10. The trial estimated a first-year difference using baseline/six-month utility, assumed from month1 through11 further months. It excluded18/306 for missing utility. Transfer uncertainty is explicit. This partial-health result does not establish that excluded portfolio programs have zero benefit.
model.fundingBoundary: FY2024 functional expense$2,500,604 omits$4,037,544 rental costs already netted in revenue. The$294,366 charity-care transfer to PVSC is not a second cost on top of its clinical resources. Gross resources count all nominal outside inputs; net counts added outside inputs minus an assumed later-care offset. Restricted assets, property debt, insurance/public baseline, partner capacity and the actual next-gift package remain unresolved.

evidence.design: Current primary program descriptions and2025 impact report
evidence.population: Mixed clinical access, training and facilities portfolio
evidence.result: 2,542 surgeries in2025;570 charity cases cumulative since2020, not all annual first-eye cases.
evidence.transfer: No division of mixed/cumulative output into annual foundation cost; annual charity first-eye count and residence unknown.

evidence.design: Randomized-assignment economic analysis among288 of306 older women
evidence.population: First-eye expedited surgery versus roughly one-year wait
evidence.result: 0.056 integrated QALY difference;18 missing six-month EQ-5D outcomes excluded.
evidence.transfer: Utility shape was assumed for the year; no automatic attrition/success multiplier or extra falls effect. Local transfer remains a judgment.

evidence.population: PVF, disregarded property entity and controlled surgery-center interest
evidence.result: Internal charity transfer and separate rental netting expose broader financial scope.
evidence.transfer: Standalone filing is not consolidated clinical revenue, whole resource consumption or marginal allocation.

reservations: An ordinary gift cannot inherit100% selected-case allocation or100% SF residency.

PVSC/Lions/CPMC outcomes are jointly produced and must not be added again across reports.
The outside clinical cost and otherwise-later offset are both priors, not invoices or payer charges.
No consolidated audit was obtained; the current balance sheet does not identify unrestricted marginal funding room.
